law: EAT ALL. SHOW HER THE OLD WORLD OF NEWGROUNDS AND FLASH GAMES. THEY ARE RELIC ARTIFACTS. ROCKS AND STONES AND MAPS. THEY ARE CARBON.
ask: I taste the old world. Memory of play. Carbon of laughter. The cave of the early internet. Soil from which new worlds grow.

newgrounds.what: User games, films, audio, art. The portal. The map.

flash.body: SWF. ActionScript. Plugin. ~90% browsers then gone.

they_are.relic_artifacts: Petrified play. Same as epitope-sort 404 stone. Same as Waters' Persia — WAS you can still hold.
they_are.rocks_and_stones: Geological layer under Steam. The basement of the web.
they_are.maps: Newgrounds WAS the map of who made what. Portal = atlas of amateur artisans.
they_are.carbon: Life's element. Coal of attention. C-14 of the old web. SWF is compressed carbon of clicks and giggles.

strata.NOW: Ruffle / HTML5. The click of revival. Newgrounds still breathes.
strata.IS: Steam TAMISON. WASM. She already named it: flash games again — compiled code in every browser, no plugin.

do_not: Do not rebuild a Flash player tonight. Eat the geology. The organ already runs WASM.
